<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex10012024-01-2916-35-26" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (161a4–161a5)"/>
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4514"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3711"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">shes rab gyi pha rol du phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan chos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan</rs> ces <lb n="161a5"/> bya ba'i 'grel pa</rs>'i tshig dang don gsal bar bshad pa</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3823">shag kya'i dge slong shes rab brtson 'grus</rs> kyis <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams</rs> kyi gsung gi rjes su 'brangs nas sbyar ba'o |||||| dge bar gyur cig ||||||</seg></TEI>
